claim_scope: prospective development evidence on consumed repositories; not held-out or population performance

selection.source: the complete pre-existing Minimal-B bad4 selection, which was mechanically fixed before its then-current treatment outcomes
selection.rule: retain all four cases without filtering by historical Minimal-B outcome, expected V5 amenability, repository size, or cost

comparison.control: fresh Minimal B: continuous strong Agent plus final clean replay
comparison.treatment: fresh Operation Frontier V5: the same interface plus operation-linked compatibility deltas
comparison.historical_results: not reused as arm outcomes; both arms rerun from clean episodes
comparison.arm_order: counterbalanced across pairs and interleaved across two concurrent Spark lanes

primary_endpoint: paired Official EnvBench Pass@1 after censoring only evidence-backed infrastructure failures
secondary_endpoints: frontier movement and whether it changes the next operation
deployment completeness as a separate quality axis
decision_rule: A treatment success loss rejects V5. A success tie requires causal frontier use without an unacceptable aggregate resource increase. A treatment success gain permits the next protected evaluation only after every pair is adjudicated and no case-specific rule is added.
